participation.context: Wrote the page, named the bad sentence, and did not strike it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Is the man the bad sentence is about, and is not in the room.
participation.name: Edward Alleyn

story.body: You set down what the yard had taught you, and you left the ungenerous sentence in place instead of smoothing it.

title: Wrote both halves and kept the bad sentence
